description: Torn robes cover a shuffling human form, still breathing despite its zombie-like unsteadiness.  Gripped by raving madness, a strange aura gathers around them as they clutch a tarnished silver talisman.

special_attacks.monster_message: The air wavers as the maddened wanderer raises their talisman!

description: A cloak of metal scales obscures this humanoid figure, heavy breaths revealing it to still be among the living.  Gripped by raving madness, bloodshot eyes glower from under a metal mask, as they grasp a silver-decorated war hammer.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "Ave martello!"  The maddened hunter raises their hammer high!
special_attacks.description: The maddened hunter's hammer gives off a blinding flash!

description: Dark robes and a heavy fur mantle conceal a human figure, still breathing despite looking to be on the edge of death.  Gripped by raving madness, they desperately clutch a golden talisman that crackles with electricity.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "May He forge your chains!"  The maddened keeper raises their symbol of judgment!
special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the maddened keeper's symbol of judgment!

description: Wearing tattered and dirty clothes and clutching a knife in one hand, this bloodshot-eyed madman is still somehow among the living.  Their other hand twitches in a series of mystical gestures.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "Fùlmina!"  The maddened hermit raises a hand crackling with lightning!
special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the maddened hermit's outstretched hand!
